units.source_text: 夫人的随身侍女们听了，都不胜悲伤。

en.t: When the lady's personal attendants heard this, they were all overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 平日对庭前草木漫不经心，如今也觉得依依不舍。

en.t: Even the grasses and trees before the garden, which they usually scarcely noticed, now seemed hard to leave behind.
Everyone covered their faces with their sleeves and sobbed quietly.

units.source_text: 木工君是髭黑大将的侍女，留住邸内。

en.t: Mokou no Kimi was an attendant of General Higekuro, and remained inside the residence.
Chujo no Kimi sent her a poem, saying:
